summary.name: Karabiner-Elements
summary.one_liner: A keyboard customizer for macOS that remaps keys and changes keyboard behavior using predefined or custom rules.
use_cases: Remap keys on a Mac keyboard
Use Vi-style navigation keys on macOS
Control the mouse pointer with the keyboard
summary.what_it_does: Karabiner-Elements is a keyboard customizer for macOS. It ships with many predefined rules that can be imported from the Internet, including Diamond cursor, Emacs key bindings anywhere, Vi key bindings, preventing unintended Command-Q, and Mouse keys. Users can also write their own rules to modify existing rules or create new ones from scratch. The page lists support for Intel-based and Apple Silicon Macs across macOS 13 through macOS 27.
notable: Predefined rules importable from the Internet, such as Emacs and Vi key bindings
Custom rules can be written to modify or create keyboard behavior
Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs
caveats: Only runs on macOS; no other platforms are named on the page
